mechanic.name: wonder capture moment (tracked silhouette, staged resolution, aura, eye gauge, camera-first)
mechanic.build: wonder_scanner v7 working tree on 2026-09-23 (after v8.1 commit 9560ffc; scan.js wired by the peer session at 23:05:59 during QA), Vite dev
mechanic.scene: scan screen as a camera: live video or photo fallback, single detected object; reveal, album and spots screens for the record side
target_devices: desktop Chrome with photo fallback (480px shell)
mechanic.network_state: offline after model load; simulation on-device; only rounded coordinates (3 decimals) leave the device when the player taps '주변 촬영지 찾기'
mechanic.camera: rear camera full-bleed video inside .overlay-wrap with a 2D canvas overlay (silhouette, shade, aura, ring, tag, staging, eye reticle)

goal: Make the tracked object itself the progress readout (etched outline filled by gauge, ghost trail, loss afterimage), make each resolution (lock, 50/100% pulse, capture spotlight, PERFECT/GREAT/GOOD punch, MISS flee, spirit pop, eye impact) read as one intention-to-consequence beat, and carry the silhouette into the record (reveal card, album detail, share card), without changing detection, cooldown, fill, grade thresholds, rewards or the save key.

baseline.capture: Headless Chrome (CDP bridge) on 390x844 mobile+touch, camera denied -> photo fallback, prefers-reduced-motion emulated per probe; overlay pixels read with getImageData, tag text via fillText spy, timings with injected frame clocks, WAAPI paused for mid-punch frames; album via IndexedDB (media.js), geo via fetch/geolocation mocks; docs/qa/v7-precision.md holds the full table.
observations: v2 control: plain bracket + built-in aura particles + holo tag; the gauge was only visible on the resonance ring, so tracking loss and progress were not readable on the object.
v2 control: grade outcome was carried by burst text, flash, chime and haptic, with no freeze, punch, spotlight or flee direction; MISS had no spatial consequence.
v2 control: the captured photo carried no bbox, so reveal/album could not show what the lens had locked on.
inferred_stages: integration (scan.js was owned and being edited by the peer session; the render/feedback numbers below come from calling overlay/staging/auras with the shared contract on the same overlay canvas, plus one smoke pass of the wired scan.js at 23:05)
perceived responsiveness on real touch devices

response_chain.owner: silhouette loss / aura cancel / staging reset
response_chain.evidence: Probe 'loss afterimage': drawLoss true at +10/+450/+1490ms and false at +1510ms, alpha 85->60->0 linear, tag '놓침 · 다시 비춰 봐' until 1490. primary_hypothesis.weak_link: render/feedback: the object under the lens did not show what was being tracked, how far the resonance had come, or where the resolution went
primary_hypothesis.problem: In v2 the only progress readout was the resonance ring and the grade burst; tracking loss, the tap consequence (MISS) and the capture had no spatial or temporal shape on the object itself, and the record (reveal/album) could not show the locked outline.
primary_hypothesis.change: Etched outline whose perimeter equals gauge with corner ticks at 25/50/75/100%, ghost trail and 1.5s loss afterimage; staging beats (120ms lock-on, 300ms pulse at 50/100%, 80ms spotlight to 0.4, 90ms freeze + 1.06/1.03 punch + 16/8 speed lines, 300ms MISS flee 60px + Ember vignette, 250ms spirit pop, 360ms eye impact); per-wonder aura skins (pool 48, zero per-frame allocation); bbox persisted as normalized box (+alts) so reveal, album and share card draw the same brass outline. Simulation truth untouched.
primary_hypothesis.expected_signal: Players can say from the outline alone how full the resonance is and whether the lens still holds the object; a MISS is seen as the object fleeing away from the tap; the reveal card shows the same outline they saw in the viewfinder.
primary_hypothesis.falsifier: Outline ticks read as noise on jittery boxes, the freeze/punch feels like a hitch on real devices, the shade makes the camera look broken, or players cannot find the eye badge (currently occluded by the Lupe bubble in the peer's layout).
primary_hypothesis.competing_explanation: The v2 flatness may have come from the identical reveal presentation rather than the missing tracking readout; v7 keeps the reveal changes (silhouette hero, burst strip) as a separate layer so the two can be attributed.

safety.simulation_truth: Detection, cooldown, fill rate, grade thresholds, rewards, BALANCE and the save key wonder-scanner:v1 are unchanged; v7 adds fields (box, alts, kind, auraSkins, auraByLabel, auraSkin, geo, eyeCal) that old saves and old moments lack and that every reader defaults (normalizeMoment, state ??=).
safety.input_policy: Freeze, punch, spotlight and shade are canvas/transform only with no pointer-events; a tap during the ring still resolves immediately; spirits stay tappable under the spotlight; AUTO still resolves after 3 cycles.
safety.return_to_rest: Silhouette afterimage ends at 1.5s, aura reaches 0 within 400ms of loss or draw stop, staging timelines are 120/300/90+200/300/250ms and reset() clears them and releases the pooled freeze; punch always restores transform:none (finished promise + timer fallback).
safety.multiplayer_authority: Not applicable; single-device offline game. Location is opt-in and never uploaded.

accessibility.redundant_signals: Progress: outline fill + ticks + tag bar + ring. Grade: burst text + colour + chime + haptic + reward line + punch. Loss: afterimage + tag + aura fade. None is the sole channel.

comparison.control: v2 build (commit after 02ec778): plain bracket, built-in aura particles, holo tag, timing ring with graded burst; photos without bbox.
comparison.variant: v7 layer: silhouette (etch + trail + afterimage), staging (lock/pulse/spotlight/freeze/punch/lines/flee/spirit), aura skins + tracking shade, eye gauge impact, camera-first album/reveal (kind/box/alts, burst strip, etch on card), spots/gimmick; same detection, fill, grades, rewards, save key.
matched_conditions: same 390x844 viewport and camera-denied photo fallback
same synthetic source geometry (720x1280) and bbox for every silhouette/staging probe
same save key wonder-scanner:v1 with additive fields only
reduced-motion probed both via caller flag and OS emulation
comparison.repetition_basis: Ring grades 3x per radius plus boundary pairs; eye precision 14 node cases; each canvas probe read at injected frame times (deterministic) and aura counts over 350-450ms rAF runs; album/reveal/spots flows run once end to end with DB read-back; scan.js smoke once after the peer's wiring.
acceptance: Etched outline perimeter equals gauge with ticks at 25/50/75/100%, brass flash at 100% then solid (measured).
Staging timings within STAGING constants and all transforms return to rest; freeze uses a pooled capture (measured).
Aura particles never exceed 48 and reach 0 within 400ms of loss (measured 41/48, 0 at 456ms).
Tracking shade outer alpha = 0.10 + gauge*0.15 and ramps to 0.4 in capture (measured 48 at g=.6, 64->102).
Reveal and album draw the same normalized box on the photo with no text over the photo (measured rect == photo rect).
Old moments without kind/box/alts and old saves keep working (measured legacy normalization).
No console errors across scan, reveal, album, spots, title in both scan.js revisions (measured 0).
Open: peer scan.js layout (.cam-bar/.cam-tools/.bubble.compact), eye badge occlusion, doSnap kind/label regression, pointerdown timeStamp.

performance.budgets: Overlay draw within one 60Hz frame; silhouette/staging/aura draw with zero per-frame allocation; aura pool <= 48 particles, <= 3 draw calls, blur 0; shade 2 draw calls; eye impact <= 12 sparks, <= 3 draw calls.
performance.basis: Desktop headless Chrome (swiftshader) only; real-device frame pacing not measured. docs/vfx contracts pass validate_vfx_spec.py (aura-tracking particles 60 = 12 trail + 48 aura, draw 8; eye-impact 14/6).
performance.measurement: Punch resolves in 403ms (PERFECT) / 243ms (GOOD) wall clock; spots list renders from 1 mocked Nominatim request; both-provider failure resolves in 7.3s with info logs only.

decisions.decision: Make the outline itself the progress bar instead of adding more HUD.
decisions.basis: The weak link was readability on the object; the ring alone did not say what was held or where it went.

decisions.decision: Merge the capture spotlight into the tracking shade (drawTrackingShade mode:'capture' ramps to 0.4) rather than stacking two even-odd fills.
decisions.basis: One layer owns 'outside is dark', avoiding double darkening and radius mismatch (Fixer change, verified 64->83->102).

decisions.decision: Freeze from a pooled capture taken at grade time, not by re-drawing the live video each frame.
decisions.basis: A live <video> keeps playing under the overlay; only a captured canvas actually freezes (verified: live source painted Ember, freeze stayed Bone).

decisions.decision: Keep every v7 field additive and default on read.
decisions.basis: Old saves/moments must keep working; verified with a legacy record and a fresh state.

decisions.decision: Location is opt-in, rounded to 3 decimals, cached 1h, never uploaded; gimmicks only multiply eventMod.
decisions.basis: Camera frames never leave the device; the geo layer must not touch simulation truth.
